|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[I've Got A Bad Feeling About... (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-ivegotabadfeelingabo022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/large/ivegotabadfeelingabout.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Light/large/ivegotabadfeelingabout.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Faithful Service”. Text: “Take one security droid into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR During your control phase, if K-2SO controls opponent's site, opponent loses 1 Force. OR If a battle was just initiated where K-2SO is with your spy, lose K-2SO to cancel that battle. OR Cancel Nevar Yalnal.”
